#/properties/cipher.rationale: A result names its cipher so its key can be checked against that cipher's key contract.

#/properties/plaintext.rationale: Taken from the README's CrackResult pseudo-signature.

#/properties/key.rationale: The allOf rules tie the key's shape to cipher, so a result is checkable without running the cracker.

#/properties/score.rationale: Scorers (quadgram fitness, index of coincidence, chi-squared) use different scales, some higher-is-better and some lower. The CRACK area fixes this before any requirement uses score.

#/properties/candidatesEvaluated.rationale: Makes crackers comparable across nations and backends.

#/properties/elapsedMs.rationale: Reported, never compared in conformance: timing depends on the machine. The backend (cpu-single, cpu-parallel, gpu) belongs to the cracker, not to the result.
